newsitem.title: INDIA: New India prime minister Gujral to visit Kashmir.
newsitem.headline: New India prime minister Gujral to visit Kashmir.

text.p: New Indian Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral will visit the northern state of Jammu and Kashmir later this month, officials said on Wednesday.

A dispute over sovereignty of the Himalayan Moslem-majority region is a key issue in talks between India and Pakistan which Gujral, as foreign minister in ousted prime minister H.D. deve Gowda's government, helped revive last month.
Gujral is due to meet Pakistani Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif during a South Asian leaders' summit in the Maldives in May.
Officials in Kashmir's summer state capital of Srinagar said Gujral would arrive in Jammu, the winter capital, on April 27, where he will present degrees to university graduates.
Gujral was sworn in as the country's 12th prime minister on Monday.
India and Pakistan have fought two of their three wars over Kashmir since independence from Britain in 1947.
India controls two-thirds of the region and accuses Pakistan of supporting an armed rebellion in the state. Pakistan, which controls the remaining third, denies the charges.
According to police and hospital sources, at least 20,000 people have been killed in the rebellion which errupted in 1990.
Jammu is a predominantly Hindu region.
